en: New reading browser that re-typesets pages
Links, bookmarks and history in the browser
GBK and UTF-16 Chinese pages are supported
Modal scrim now fades the page, not darkens it
Modal cards share one solid outline
Apps now live in one tool drawer grid
The language pack adds browser strings
Use a full install or reflash the data partition
zh: 新增网页阅读 App，按阅读字号重排正文
浏览器支持页面链接、书签与访问历史
中文网页自动识别 GBK 与 UTF-16
弹窗遮罩改为褪色，减少闪屏与残影
弹窗卡片统一为实线边框
应用统一进入「我的」工具网格
语言包新增浏览器文案
建议完整安装或重刷数据分区
